text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants y.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
CanCompose(x) ::: x can compose.
Compose(x) ::: x will compose.

Premises:
Likes(george, music) → Wants(george, compose)
HasAccess(george, program) → CanCompose(george)
CanCompose(george) ∧ Wants(george, compose) → Compose(george)

Conclusion:
Likes(george, music) ∧ HasAccess(george, program) → Compose(george)
